other_conditions: must belong to Most Backward Classes (MBC) or Denotified Communities (DNC)
must be studying in classes 3rd to 6th in government or government‑aided schools
must not be from Chennai District
preference is given to girls from families headed by widows or destitute parents
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹500 per annum for classes 3rd‑5th and ₹1,000 per annum for class 6.
